pagetitle: "AFLEARN MICS6 Analysis Guide"

```{=html}
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
:root {
  --af-navy: #eef3f7;
  --af-on: #0d0d52;
  --af-card: #ffffff;
  --af-chip: #d6e8ff;
  --af-bright: #0049ff;
  --af-cyan: #0dd8f9;
  --af-orange: #ffad44;
  --af-muted: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.68);
  --af-soft: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.46);
  --af-hairline: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.12);
  --af-card-on: #0d0d52;
  --af-card-muted: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.66);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--af-navy);
  color: var(--af-on);
  font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.af-wrap {
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

/* ---------- Nav ---------- */
.af-nav {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  background: var(--af-navy);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
}

.af-nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  height: 60px;
}

.af-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--af-on);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.af-brand img { height: 30px; width: 30px; border-radius: 8px; display: block; }

.af-brand span {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.af-nav-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; }

.af-search {
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 1 340px;
}

.af-search input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 8px 12px 8px 34px;
  border: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--af-card);
  color: var(--af-on);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  outline: none;
}

.af-search input::placeholder { color: var(--af-soft); }

.af-search input:focus {
  border-color: var(--af-bright);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 73, 255, 0.14);
}

.af-search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 12px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  color: var(--af-soft);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.af-kbd {
  position: absolute;
  right: 10px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--af-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.af-results {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  max-height: 340px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--af-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.14);
  display: none;
  padding: 6px;
}

.af-results.open { display: block; }

.af-results a {
  display: block;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--af-card-on);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.af-results a small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--af-card-muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.af-results a:hover,
.af-results a.active { background: var(--af-chip); }

.af-results .af-empty {
  padding: 10px;
  color: var(--af-card-muted);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.af-nav-link {
  color: var(--af-bright);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.af-nav-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.af-gh { color: var(--af-on); display: flex; align-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.af-gh:hover { color: var(--af-bright); }
.af-gh svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.af-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.35fr 0.65fr;
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 34px 0 26px;
}

.af-hero h1 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--af-bright);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.af-hero p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--af-muted);
  max-width: 56ch;
}

.af-lockup { text-align: right; }
.af-lockup img { max-width: 190px; width: 100%; height: auto; display: inline-block; }

/* ---------- Cards ---------- */
.af-section-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--af-soft);
  margin: 10px 0 12px;
}

.af-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 44px;
}

.af-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--af-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 18px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--af-card-on);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.05);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.af-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.12);
  border-color: var(--af-orange);
}

.af-card-icon { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: block; }

.af-card h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.af-chip {
  align-self: flex-start;
  background: var(--af-chip);
  color: var(--af-on);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.af-card p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--af-card-muted);
}

.af-foot {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
  padding: 18px 0 34px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--af-soft);
}

.af-foot a { color: var(--af-bright); text-decoration: none; }
.af-foot a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .af-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .af-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .af-lockup { text-align: left; }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .af-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .af-search { flex-basis: 100%; order: 3; }
  .af-nav-inner { height: auto; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 10px 0; }
  .af-hero h1 { font-size: 1.6rem; }
}
</style>

<nav class="af-nav">
  <div class="af-wrap af-nav-inner">
    <a class="af-brand" href="index.html">
      <img src="files/AFLEARN-mark-nav.png"
           onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='files/AFLEARN-mark-nav.svg'"
           alt="AFLEARN">
      <span>MICS6 Analysis Guide</span>
    </a>
    <div class="af-nav-spacer"></div>
    <div class="af-search">
      <svg class="af-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"></path>
      </svg>
      <input id="af-q" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"
             placeholder="Search the guide" aria-label="Search the guide">
      <span class="af-kbd">Ctrl K</span>
      <div id="af-results" class="af-results"></div>
    </div>
    <a class="af-nav-link" href="c01-getting-data.html">Start reading</a>
    <a class="af-gh" href="https://github.com/datafirst-aflearn/MICS6-Guide"
       target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="GitHub repository">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">

      </svg>
    </a>
  </div>
</nav>

  <div>

  </div>
  <div class="af-lockup">
    <img src="files/AFLEARN-datahub-lockup.png"
         onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='files/AFLEARN-datahub-lockup.svg'"
         alt="AFLEARN DataHub">

<main class="af-wrap">
  <p class="af-section-label">Seven sections</p>
  <div class="af-grid">

    <a class="af-card" href="c01-getting-data.html">

      <h3>1. Getting MICS6 data</h3>
      <span class="af-chip">Guide</span>
     
    </a>

    <a class="af-card" href="c02-whats-in-data.html">

    <a class="af-card" href="c03-prepare-unicef.html">

<script>
(function () {
  var destinations = [
    { t: "Getting MICS6 data", s: "Section 1", u: "c01-getting-data.html" },
    { t: "Getting data from UNICEF MICS", s: "Section 1", u: "c01-unicef.html" },
    { t: "Organising the UNICEF download", s: "Section 1", u: "c01-organise.html" },
    { t: "Getting data from IPUMS MICS", s: "Section 1", u: "c01-ipums.html" },

    { t: "What's in MICS6 data?", s: "Section 2", u: "c02-whats-in-data.html" },
    { t: "Files, units of observation and identifiers", s: "Section 2", u: "c02-files.html" },
    { t: "Who is in the fs sample?", s: "Section 2", u: "c02-fs-sample.html" },
    { t: "Foundational learning skills", s: "Section 2", u: "c02-fls.html" },
    { t: "Understanding the reading assessment", s: "Section 2", u: "c02-reading.html" },
    { t: "Understanding the numeracy assessment", s: "Section 2", u: "c02-numeracy.html" },

    { t: "Preparing UNICEF data", s: "Section 3", u: "c03-prepare-unicef.html" },
    { t: "Merging MICS6 files within a country", s: "Section 3", u: "c03-merge.html" },
    { t: "Harmonising variables across countries", s: "Section 3", u: "c03-harmonise.html" },
    { t: "Constructing research-ready reading variables", s: "Section 3", u: "c03-reading.html" },

    { t: "Preparing IPUMS data", s: "Section 4", u: "c04-prepare-ipums.html" },
    { t: "Adding the correct reading data to an IPUMS extract", s: "Section 4", u: "c04-ipums-reading.html" },
    { t: "Validating the combined file", s: "Section 4", u: "c04-validate.html" },

    { t: "Survey design, weights and standard errors", s: "Section 5", u: "c05-survey-design.html" },
    { t: "Which MICS weight should I use?", s: "Section 5", u: "c05-weights.html" },
    { t: "Analysing a single survey", s: "Section 5", u: "c05-single-survey.html" },
    { t: "Combining MICS6 surveys", s: "Section 5", u: "c05-pooling.html" },
    { t: "Standard errors and confidence intervals", s: "Section 5", u: "c05-standard-errors.html" },
    { t: "Survey design checklist", s: "Section 5", u: "c05-checklist.html" },

    { t: "Worked examples", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-worked-examples.html" },
    { t: "Prepare the analysis data", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-prepare-analysis.html" },
    { t: "Who is assessed?", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-who-assessed.html" },
    { t: "Indicators versus distributions", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-numeracy-distributions.html" },
    { t: "Missing reading outcomes", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-reading-status.html" },
    { t: "Reading language and coverage", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-reading-language.html" },
    { t: "Learning inequalities by wealth", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-wealth.html" },
    { t: "In-school and out-of-school children", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-schooling-status.html" },
    { t: "Learning by grade and age", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-grade-trajectories.html" },
    { t: "Timing within the school year", s: "Section 6", u: "c06-school-timing.html" },

    { t: "Technical documentation", s: "Section 7", u: "c07-technical.html" },
    { t: "FS harmonisation methods", s: "Section 7", u: "c07-fs-harmonisation.html" },
    { t: "Reading-variable construction", s: "Section 7", u: "c07-reading-construction.html" },
    { t: "Country-specific issues", s: "Section 7", u: "c07-country-issues.html" },
    { t: "Variable crosswalks and dictionaries", s: "Section 7", u: "c07-crosswalks.html" },
    { t: "Why current_grade is not the child's grade", s: "Section 7", u: "c07-current-grade.html" },
    { t: "Validation and reproducibility", s: "Section 7", u: "c07-validation.html" }
  ];

  var input = document.getElementById("af-q");
  var box = document.getElementById("af-results");
  if (!input || !box) return;

  var matches = [];
  var cursor = -1;

  function render(list) {
    matches = list;
    cursor = list.length ? 0 : -1;
    if (!list.length) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="af-empty">No matching page</div>';
      box.classList.add("open");
      return;
    }
    box.innerHTML = list.map(function (d, i) {
      return '<a href="' + d.u + '"' + (i === 0 ? ' class="active"' : '') + '>' +
        d.t + '<small>' + d.s + '</small></a>';
    }).join("");
    box.classList.add("open");
  }

  function close() {
    box.classList.remove("open");
    cursor = -1;
  }

  function highlight() {
    var links = box.querySelectorAll("a");
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
      links[i].classList.toggle("active", i === cursor);
    }
    if (cursor >= 0 && links[cursor]) {
      links[cursor].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    }
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    var q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) { close(); return; }
    render(destinations.filter(function (d) {
      return (d.t + " " + d.s).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
    }).slice(0, 12));
  });

  input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") { close(); input.blur(); return; }
    if (!box.classList.contains("open")) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      cursor = Math.min(cursor + 1, matches.length - 1);
      highlight();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      cursor = Math.max(cursor - 1, 0);
      highlight();
    } else if (e.key === "Enter" && cursor >= 0 && matches[cursor]) {
      e.preventDefault();
      window.location.href = matches[cursor].u;
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (e.key === "k" || e.key === "K")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      input.focus();
      input.select();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest(".af-search")) close();
  });
})();
</script>
```
